title: 4D and 5D Layer Codes through Color Routing
summary: We introduce and explicit Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) code construction that generalizes the Layer codes to $D=4,5$ dimensions. Much like its predecessor, the present construction is based on embedding quantum low-density parity check (qLDPC) codes; from an $[[n,k,d]]$ code with energy barrier $Δ$, we obtain a $D=4,5$ dimensional Layer code with parameters $[[Θ(n^{D/(D-2)}), k, Θ(dn^{1/(D-2)})]]$ and energy barrier $Ω(Δ)$.
